10.1 30-Day Return Policy. Framework offers a voluntary return period. You may request to return an eligible Product for any or no reason within 30 days of the date the Product was delivered to you. 10.2 Eligibility and Condition. To be eligible for a refund, the Product must be returned in its original packaging, including all accessories and components. Framework reserves the right to reduce the refund amount or reject the return if the Product shows signs of wear, damage, or unauthorized modification. 10.3 Return Shipping Costs. Unless the Product is being returned due to a confirmed defect covered by our Limited Warranty (Article 12), you are responsible for the costs of shipping the Product back to our designated return center. 10.4 Refunds.
